task_name: Argument-Closed Deterministic Full-Registry Depth-3 Closure Audit
decision_rationale: Full-registry audit under pre-fixed argument-closed grammar expanded irreducible panel from ADR-0165's 6 handpicked recipes to 57 equivalence classes across 97 recipes. For all 41 length-adequate classes (intermediate L >= 6), the neural substrate passes oracle floor (mean Oracle EM = 0.9000 >= 0.85) and exhaustive baseline achieves near-ceiling EM (0.9352 >= 0.95 across all 4 bundles and 5 data seeds), robustly supporting depth <= 3 closure on length-adequate inputs. However, 16 classes exhibit intermediate length collapse under SELECT (L < 6), collapsing Oracle EM to subthreshold levels (35 failure classes). In accordance with task protocol, ADR-0165 is QUALIFIED and closure is unconfirmed on length-contracting failure classes.
